exposure: Modified breast pump suction pattern (15 minutes non-nutritive + 5 minutes nutritive suction cycles)
outcome: Total expressed milk volume after 20 minutes
Expressed milk volume by postpartum day
Expressed milk volume by mode of birth
Expressed milk volume by prior experience breastfeeding
cohort: The study included 40 breastfeeding patients who gave birth after 36 weeks gestation, had an infant aged <=96-hour old, and a clinical indication to express milk with a breast pump.
finding: The total colostrum/milk expression volume after 20 minutes was significantly improved compared to 15 minutes of pumping, with the additional 5 minutes yielding 36% of the total milk yield.
